title: The Air War vs. the Ground Game: An Analysis of Multichannel Marketing in U.S. Presidential Elections
eligible_reason: BLP-type random-coefficient aggregate vote-share model with IV/GMM; television advertising and number of field offices are continuous regressors at the county-party-year level. No staggered binary treatment, no DiD.
design_notes: MainAnalysis.m with gmm_obj_BLP*.m and SQUAREM share inversion; robustness models M1-M3.
data_files_note: Readme: a subset of 15,744 county-party-year observations; advertising variables are simulated because of an NDA.
data_provenance_note: Advertising regressors simulated from first-stage coefficients; observation subset.
screener_notes: No article text or PDF available locally (data/text and papers/ checked Nov 2); the OpenAlex abstract in data/frame/mksc.jsonl is a one-sentence summary or empty. Design read from the README and the main-results code; no package code was run.
